purpose: Open literature sources for point-specific anatomy and high-risk needling review without canonical writes.

sources.title: Development of an ultrasound-imaging procedure and acquisition of ultrasound images of acupuncture points for safety and accuracy of needle insertion
limitations: The paper does not publish a complete point-by-point anatomy table for all 44 points.
The study explicitly says it was not oriented toward defining universal needling depth.

sources.title: Retrospective study using MRI to measure depths of acupuncture points in neck and shoulder region
limitations: Measured distances vary with BMI, sex, angle, and individual anatomy.
Do not convert population means into a universal safe depth.

sources.title: Ultrasound Visualization of Radial Nerve Excursion During Acupuncture
limitations: A nearby nerve is an anatomy and safety relationship, not an efficacy claim.
The article's experiment centers on radial nerve movement and cites several additional point-nerve examples in its introduction.

sources.title: Clinical anatomy study on acupuncture safety of Tiantu (CV22) and Qishe (ST11)
limitations: Cadaver observations require clinical and textbook review before canonical use.
Abstract-level extraction only in this staging batch.

sources.title: Anatomical study of the acupoint Baihui (GV20)
limitations: Anatomical proximity does not establish clinical efficacy.

sources.title: Proposed catalog of the neuroanatomy and the stratified anatomy for the 361 acupuncture points of 14 channels
limitations: The abstract confirms 361-point scope, but the point-level catalog was not accessible for verified extraction in this batch.
Do not infer point anatomy from the abstract.
